criterion_definition: lower bound of Delta > -0.005 on macro-domain Dice and no domain collapse
operationalization: macro_domain_mean_true_delta_dice lower 95% CI bound > -0.005 and no domain collapse
what_the_claim_covers: NON-INFERIORITY of the routed system vs the frozen global reference on the macro-domain mean true paired DeltaDice, on ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT (4957), at the frozen budget grid.
The lower 95% CI bound of the macro-domain mean Delta exceeds -0.005 at every informative budget (0.10/0.25/0.50) and at the degenerate 1.00 budget.
No domain collapse: no domain shows a routed mean at or below -0.01 while another domain is positive (F5 not triggered).
The global output remains AVAILABLE until the final selection (no destructive replacement before the final decision); SKIP and EXECUTE_THEN_REJECT both return the global output.
what_the_claim_does_NOT_cover: It is NOT a per-domain IMPROVEMENT claim. Routed benefit is strongly heterogeneous: KUB carries most of the positive mean; BUSI and KVASIR are near zero and KVASIR is marginally negative at 0.25/0.50 (but far above the -0.01 collapse threshold).
It is NOT a claim that no individual sample is harmed: the harmful activation rate among routed samples is strictly positive at every budget.
It is NOT a holdout or TEST claim: it is scoped to ROUTER_DEVELOPMENT only; ROUTER_HOLDOUT, VAL808 and TEST are untouched.
It is NOT a claim about the C9 post-safety comparator (not evaluated in Phase25E).
It is NOT a measured-latency or real-deployment claim: all compute is an ANALYTICAL MAC LOWER BOUND.
It is NOT a claim about the always-refine system; it compares the ROUTED system against the global-only reference.
